title: LOOK: Sotto turns over clean office to Gatchalian

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Contributed photos showed that the office that former Senate President Vicente Sotto III will turn over to Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian was clean and seemingly untouched. Except for what appeared to be an internet cable, no part of the office had been dismantled. Gatchalian’s soon-to-be office still had a 10-seat conference table, two couches, a coffee table, office desks, lights, a carpet, and a lamp. This was in contrast to Sotto’s new office as Senate president pro tempore, which was left completely bare after Sen. Jinggoy Estrada vacated it.
